newsitem.title: CONGO: Members of Mobutu's family take refuge in Congo.
newsitem.headline: Members of Mobutu's family take refuge in Congo.

text.p: Members of President Mobutu Sese Seko's family have joined a steady flow of Zaireans taking refuge in neighbouring Congo in the face of advances by rebels in the east, the Congolese Red Cross said on Tuesday.
Ida Victorine Nze, president of the organisation, gave no details of who the family members were but told reporters they left Kinshasa on Monday fearing things could take a turn for the worse.
She said other Zairean families had done the same. Church sources said 85 Zaireans had arrived on Monday.
Diplomatic sources said small groups of Americans living in Kinshasa had started arriving in Brazzaville, complaining of harassment by Zaireans accusing Washington of supporting the rebels.
Mobutu is currently in Europe, where he has spent most of his time since prostate cancer surgery there in August.
The rebels, fighting to overthrow Mobutu, at the weekend captured Zaire's third largest city of Kisangani.
